server.note: Add Server: 'Ajouter un serveur'; Remove Server: 'Retirer le serveur' (existing) — 'retirer' since the server is removed from the list, not deleted.

tab.note: Masculine. New Tab: 'Nouvel onglet'; Close Tab: 'Fermer l'onglet'.

view.note: Feminine. View limit: 'limite de vues'. New strings, not yet translated in fr.json. Distinct from the View menu, which is 'Voir' in the existing menu bar.

popout window.note: Not yet translated in desktop fr.json. Verb 'pop out': 'détacher'. The Calls fr.json uses 'Sortir', which is ambiguous — avoid.

system tray.note: Existing settings strings use 'zone de notification'; some dialogs use 'barre d'état' or 'barre des tâches' — prefer 'zone de notification' for the tray itself.

notification area.note: Same rendering as system tray; matches Windows French terminology.

minimize to tray.target: réduire dans la zone de notification
minimize to tray.note: Existing dialog title says 'Réduire dans la barre des tâches', inconsistent with the settings wording — prefer 'zone de notification'.

Dock.note: Apple keeps 'Dock' (masculine) in French macOS; existing: 'Faire rebondir l'icône du Dock'.

badge.note: Masculine; existing: 'badge rouge' for the unread badge.

flash.note: Existing: 'icône de la barre des tâches clignotante'.

start app on login.note: Existing setting label. Launch minimized: 'Lancer l'application en mode réduit'.

check for updates.note: 'mise à jour' is reserved for app updates per community rules ('modifier' is used for editing).

developer tools.note: Existing menu wording; matches Chromium French.

spell checker.note: Setting label in existing fr.json: 'Vérifier l'orthographe'.

authentication secret.note: New strings, not yet translated in fr.json; 'secret' (m.) is standard French security vocabulary.

title bar.note: Native title bar: 'barre de titre native'.

zoom.note: Zoom In/Out in existing menus: 'Zoomer' / 'Dézoomer'; Actual Size: 'Taille réelle'.

full screen.note: Toggle Full Screen: 'Basculer en plein écran' (existing).

clear data.note: Clear All Data: 'Effacer toutes les données'; Clear Cache and Reload: 'Effacer le cache et recharger' (existing).

logging level.note: Existing setting label. Show logs: 'Afficher les logs' in existing menu — 'journaux' is the more French alternative.
